## Goal
Implement the first **Cursor-owned** vertical slice of Vellistry on `feat/vel-imp-001-auth-library`: existing sign-in â†’ account-owned Library list/create, real empty/populated state differentiation, and two-disposable-account isolation tests.

## Source instructions
- [VEL-TASK-0004 YAML](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/feat/vel-imp-001-auth-library/docs/agent-workflow/tasks/VEL-TASK-0004.yaml)
- [Cursor execution prompt + acceptance/negative tests](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/feat/vel-imp-001-auth-library/docs/plans/VEL-IMP-001-CURSOR-KICKOFF-2026-10-11.md)
- Existing runtime: `apps/web/src/app/books/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/api/books/route.ts`, `apps/api/src/modules/books/*`.
- [Original editable Figma master](https://www.figma.com/design/krXupCfSLUnOQxEOjIlp9U?node-id=27-10); [design-evidence PR #57](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/57) remains separate/unmerged when created.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Existing web/API auth/books code audited; minimum necessary code diff only.
- [ ] Empty and populated Library render mutually exclusively; loading/error/401 are distinct and retryable.
- [ ] After logout or synthetic account switch, no books or late responses from the previous account are visible.
- [ ] Alice/Bob local Supabase auth and RLS negative tests: owned books visible, foreign books inaccessible.
- [ ] Server rejects bad titles and never trusts submitted `owner_id`.
- [ ] No AI key required for core Library writing workflow.
- [ ] `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, focused tests executed with actual exit codes, or explicit NOT RUN.
- [ ] Cursor ExecutionBundle documents FACT/INTERPRETATION/PROPOSAL, exact commit and reproducible tests.
- [ ] PR reviewed separately before merge; no deployment or release claims.

## Scope boundary
No schema migrations, chapter create/edit/save, real Tiptap, paid AI, provider keys, production data, public deployments, or new product architecture. First slice is local synthetic development only. The residual signed-out, unexpired Supabase JWT/direct PostgREST access issue remains a private-pilot blocker.

**Owner direction** (2026-10-11): Leave current Figma master imperfect and refine UI during implementation; proceed with implementation in **Cursor**. This authorizes only a bounded initial slice, not all future engineering, private-pilot or release gates.
title: VEL-IMP-001 | Cursor: authenticated and isolated author Library
